issues.what: the near terrain and mid disk are a soft brushed smear, with linear streaks along the view, so the surface reads as stretched procedural texture rather than clouds
issues.fix: replace the directional smear with finer cloud structure that stays sharp from the near terrain up to the limb

issues.what: at native size the disk is airbrushed and softly streaked, with no fine turbulence, so the crops give away the render
issues.fix: add small-scale cloud relief and break up the parallel streaks so a native crop holds up

issues.what: the nearest ground keeps the same directional smear and loses detail
issues.fix: keep the near-field texture as crisp as the mid disk

issues.what: a faint greenish iridescent smudge sits in the starfield
issues.fix: remove the colored flare so the sky is only stars and faint dust

issues.where: crop P, illuminated mid-disc down toward the lower terminator
issues.what: Cloud texture stretches into long, nearly parallel streaks and loses fine structure, making the globe look airbrushed.
issues.fix: Use spherical cloud mapping that preserves texel density and introduce smaller, irregular breaks in the long bands.

issues.where: crops A and E, bright horizon and blue midground below it
issues.what: Much of the surface detail smears into similarly angled bands. The bright far layer loses separation from the limb glow.
issues.fix: Keep distinct cloud shapes at several scales and preserve local contrast beneath the atmospheric scattering.

issues.where: crop H, small moon to the right of the ring plane
issues.what: The moon reads as a soft oval with a smeared brightness gradient and no distinct lit edge or surface relief.
issues.fix: Resolve the silhouette and terminator at output scale and add subtle, irregular albedo or relief.

issues.where: crops J and Q, outer ring tips at the horizon
issues.what: The thinnest bright ring ends as a sharp needle against the cyan haze, especially at the left intersection.
issues.fix: Attenuate ring brightness continuously through the atmospheric path and antialias the last visible pixels.

issues.where: crops C and G, upper-right globe limb
issues.what: The almost white rim sits over a broader blue halo, reading as a separate outline rather than one continuous falloff.
issues.fix: Reduce the rim peak and blend the inner rim and outer glow into a single scattering profile.

issues.where: crops L and M, stars in the dark sky to the right of the rings
issues.what: Several brighter stars are softened into colored dashes or irregular blobs instead of compact points.
issues.fix: Use a compact, antialiased star profile and reserve broad bloom for the brightest sources.
